req.title: Login required for delete
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they POST /<id>/delete.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that anonymous users should be redirected to the login page when attempting to delete a post. This behavior ensures that only authenticated users can perform delete operations, maintaining the integrity and security of the application. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of this requirement.

tests.name: test_delete_redirects_anonymous_user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'
